tools.name: get_my_brand
tools.title: Get my brand
tools.description: Show the brand you saved, so research and ads are tailored to your business.

tools.name: save_my_brand
tools.title: Save my brand
tools.description: Save your brand from your website or a short description of what you sell.

tools.name: clear_my_brand
tools.title: Clear my brand
tools.description: Remove your saved brand so you can start over with a different one.

tools.name: add_product
tools.title: Add a product
tools.description: Save one of your products from its product page, with its name, price and photos.

tools.name: list_my_products
tools.title: List my products
tools.description: List the products you have saved.

tools.name: remove_product
tools.title: Remove a product
tools.description: Remove a product you saved earlier.

tools.name: find_competitors
tools.title: Find competitors
tools.description: Find the brands in your space that are advertising right now, ranked by how many ads they run.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.title: Search brands
tools.description: Look up a brand by name to see whether its ads are available.

tools.name: add_brand
tools.title: Track a brand
tools.description: Start tracking a brand so you can explore its ads.

tools.name: get_brand_ads
tools.title: See a brand's ads
tools.description: See a brand's ads with the hook, format, copy and how long each one has been running.

tools.name: get_brand_stats
tools.title: Brand ad summary
tools.description: Get a summary of a brand's advertising: how many ads, which formats and how long they run.

tools.name: search_ads
tools.title: Search ads by idea
tools.description: Search a brand's ads by idea, such as "before and after" or "social proof".

tools.name: compare_brands
tools.title: Compare brands
tools.description: Compare the advertising of two or more brands side by side.

tools.name: generate_brief
tools.title: Write a strategy brief
tools.description: Get a written brief on one brand's ad strategy.

tools.name: get_instagram_content
tools.title: See Instagram posts
tools.description: See a brand's recent Instagram posts and reels.

tools.name: research_tiktok_ads
tools.title: Research TikTok ads
tools.description: Find TikTok ads running for a brand or a topic.

tools.name: clone_tiktok_ad
tools.title: Script from a TikTok ad
tools.description: Turn a TikTok ad into a shot-by-shot script for your own product that you can film yourself.

tools.name: research_keywords
tools.title: Research keywords
tools.description: Get Google keyword ideas with search volume and cost estimates for a product or topic.

tools.name: research_competitor_keywords
tools.title: Competitor keywords
tools.description: See the Google keywords a competitor's website shows up for.

tools.name: clone_ad
tools.title: Clone an image ad
tools.description: Rebuild a competitor's image ad for your own brand and product.

tools.name: clone_video_ad
tools.title: Clone a video ad
tools.description: Write a video ad for your brand based on a competitor's ad, a reel, a TikTok or your own video. You review the script first.

tools.name: clone_from_script
tools.title: Video ad from a script
tools.description: Make a video ad for your brand from a script you wrote.

tools.name: clone_from_concept
tools.title: Video ad from an idea
tools.description: Make a video ad for your brand from an idea described in plain English.

tools.name: revise_video_brief
tools.title: Change a video script
tools.description: Change a video ad's script, language or on-screen captions.

tools.name: approve_video_clone
tools.title: Approve a video
tools.description: Approve a video script so the video gets made. Nothing is made until you approve.

tools.name: check_video_status
tools.title: Check a video
tools.description: Check on a video ad that is being made and get the finished video.

tools.name: list_my_creatives
tools.title: List my creatives
tools.description: List the images and videos in your creative library.

tools.name: connect_ad_account
tools.title: Connect an ad account
tools.description: Get a link to connect your own ad account on Meta, Google, TikTok, X or ChatGPT Ads.

tools.name: list_ad_accounts
tools.title: List ad accounts
tools.description: List the ad accounts you have connected.

tools.name: inspect_ad_account
tools.title: Check an ad account
tools.description: Check whether a connected ad account is ready to run ads.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns in a connected ad account and their status.

tools.name: get_account_performance
tools.title: See performance
tools.description: See real spend, clicks and conversions from your connected ad account.

tools.name: search_ad_targeting
tools.title: Look up targeting
tools.description: Look up targeting options for a campaign, such as interests, locations and audiences.

tools.name: create_audience
tools.title: Create an audience
tools.description: Create an audience in your Meta account, such as website visitors or people similar to your customers.

tools.name: launch_campaign
tools.title: Launch a campaign
tools.description: Create a new campaign in your connected ad account. It starts paused, after you confirm a preview.

tools.name: launch_meta_ad
tools.title: Launch a Meta ad
tools.description: Launch your own images or videos as a Facebook and Instagram ad. It starts paused, after you confirm a preview.

tools.name: launch_cloned_ad
tools.title: Launch a cloned ad
tools.description: Launch an image ad you cloned as a Facebook and Instagram ad. It starts paused, after you confirm a preview.

tools.name: launch_search_campaign
tools.title: Launch Google Search
tools.description: Launch a Google Search campaign with your keywords and ad text. It starts paused, after you confirm a preview.

tools.name: launch_pmax_campaign
tools.title: Launch Performance Max
tools.description: Launch a Google Performance Max campaign. It starts paused, after you confirm a preview.

tools.name: launch_tiktok_campaign
tools.title: Launch a TikTok campaign
tools.description: Launch a TikTok campaign with your video. It starts paused, after you confirm a preview.

tools.name: create_ad_group
tools.title: Add an ad group
tools.description: Add an ad group, or more ads, to a campaign you already have.

tools.name: update_keywords
tools.title: Update keywords
tools.description: Add, pause or remove keywords in a Google Search campaign.

tools.name: add_negative_keywords
tools.title: Add negative keywords
tools.description: Stop a Google campaign from showing on searches you do not want.

tools.name: update_campaign_locations
tools.title: Change locations
tools.description: Change the places a campaign shows in.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.title: Change a budget
tools.description: Change a campaign's daily budget, after you confirm a preview.

tools.name: pause_campaign
tools.title: Pause a campaign
tools.description: Pause a running campaign so it stops spending.

tools.name: resume_campaign
tools.title: Resume a campaign
tools.description: Turn a paused campaign back on, after you confirm.
